events.summary: Necrites kill Jherana Rure, ending the counterinsurgency.
events.quote: Necrites killed Jherana Rure, ending the counterinsurgency.

events.summary: Farrel and his followers become vigilantes battling Icatians and followers of Tourach.
events.quote: Farrel and his followers became a formidable band of vigilantes, battling Icatians and followers of Tourach.

events.summary: Icatian phalanxes hold their ranks to the end after the wall is breached.
events.quote: Even after the wall was breached in half a dozen places, the phalanxes fought on

events.summary: Gustha Ebbasdotter wins a duel against Zur, who boasts he'll eat her soul.
events.quote: He boasted that he would eat my soul—but all he ate were his words.

events.summary: The orcs fail in their early battle for Montford and temper bloodlust with cowardice.
events.quote: Unsuccessful in their early battle for Montford, the orcs quickly tempered their bloodlust with cowardice.

events.summary: Freyalise cleanses the Juniper Order of the plagues of Kjeldor and grants a home in Fyndhorn.
events.quote: Freyalise has cleansed our bodies and minds of the plagues of Kjeldor

events.summary: Baron Sengir kills the An-Zerrins and then uses their ruins.
events.quote: ever since I first killed them.

events.summary: Chasing Lim-Dul, the White Shield sees a ridge suddenly crumble.
events.quote: We were chasing Lim-Dûl when the ridge in front of us suddenly crumbled.

events.summary: Lim-Dul pledges to raise the Kjeldoran dead as servants.
events.quote: They shall kill those whom once they loved.
